architecture.title: 12-Lead Beat Extraction & Normalization
architecture.dims: [B, N, 12, 120] @ 100 Hz (1.2 s R-peak centered) + beat_meta [24]
architecture.summary: Resamples 12-lead ECGs to 100 Hz, detects R-peaks with Pan-Tompkins + NeuroKit2 cross-validation, crops 1.2 s R-peak windows with cosine-tapered masks, normalizes morphology per beat, and extracts 24 lead-wise scale features (12 IQR σ + 12 max |x|).
architecture.formula: x_norm = (x - median) / sigma,  beat_meta = [log(sigma), amax] in R^24
architecture.finding: Standardizing morphology scales enables strong zero-shot cross-continental transfer across PTB-XL, Georgia, and Chapman.

architecture.title: Three Disentangled Lead-Wise Conv1D Encoders
architecture.dims: mu, logvar in R^32  |  z_age in R^8  |  z_sex in R^8
architecture.summary: Grouped depthwise Conv1d blocks (32 -> 64 channels, kernel=7, GroupNorm, Squeeze-and-Excitation) run independently for each of the 12 leads across three decoupled streams: morphology VAE (z), age stream (z_age), and sex stream (z_sex).
architecture.formula: z ~ N(mu(x), diag(sigma^2)),  pred_age(z_age, meta),  pred_sex(z_sex, meta)
architecture.finding: Separating demographic streams prevents age/sex gradients from polluting unsupervised beat clustering on the SOM.

architecture.title: Closed-Form Probe Residualization
architecture.dims: 2D subspace projection in R^32 (Gram-Schmidt u_age _|_ u_sex)
architecture.summary: Fits closed-form ridge age regression and L2 logistic sex classification probes directly on frozen Phase-1 latent codes, then projects out the orthonormalized age and sex subspaces before SOM distance computation.
architecture.formula: z_res = z - (z . u_age) u_age - (z . u_sex_|_) u_sex_|_
architecture.finding: Drops demographic leakage to R^2 -> 0.00 / AUROC -> 0.50 in z_res while preserving clinical Rec AMI (matched-k).

architecture.title: Toroidal 8×8 Probabilistic SOM + FiLM Decoder
architecture.dims: Codebook E in R^(8x8x32)  |  Wrap-around Von-Neumann neighborhood
architecture.summary: Maps residualized latents z_res to a 64-unit toroidal SOM using Student-t soft assignments q_ik, periodic wrap-around neighbor coupling (beta), DEC cluster sharpening KL(p || q) (gamma), and temporal smoothness along consecutive beats (tau). FiLM-conditioned LeadWiseConvDecoder decodes every cell embedding to a 12-lead ECG prototype.
architecture.formula: q_ik propto (1 + ||z_res - e_k||^2 / alpha)^(-(alpha+1)/2),  L = theta*ELBO + gamma*KL(p||q) + beta*L_som + tau*L_temp
architecture.finding: Pruned 8×8 SOM achieves 100% interpretable prototypes and outperforms 4×4 and 16×16 grids on matched-k record AMI.

architecture.title: 3-Phase Training & Pruned Architecture
architecture.dims: 10 pretrain ep -> Closed-form probes -> 24 joint ep (bf16 + GPU preload)
architecture.summary: Phase 1 trains morphology VAE + demographic predictors; Phase 1.5/1.6 fits and freezes age/sex residualization probes; Phase 2 initializes SOM prototypes via k-means/grad steps; Phase 3 jointly refines VAE, SOM, and heads with val-NMI checkpoint selection.
architecture.formula: Pruned defaults: eta=0, age_corr_lambda_max=0, use_rr=False, probe_refit=0
architecture.finding: 3-seed ablation proved pruned defaults match full auxiliary complexity with cleaner cross-cohort robustness (0.1914 Georgia / 0.1989 Chapman Rec AMI).

architecture.title: Stronger UDA (BW-OT + Hybrid Damped-DEC + SWA)
architecture.dims: 0-ep analytical BW-OT (~0.1s) + 8-ep Hybrid DEC (alpha_rec=0.35, rho=0.75) + SWA
architecture.summary: Solves demographic shift analytically via closed-form FP64 Bures-Wasserstein Gaussian optimal transport folded into linear weights (enc_sex, enc_age, amp_proj_*), paired with Hybrid Beat+Record Damped-DEC + Cosine LR + Stochastic Weight Averaging on morphology/SOM.
architecture.finding: BW-OT raises Sex AUROC on 8/8 transfer pairs (0.7988 -> 0.8074, 0 labels); Hybrid DEC+SWA lifts PTB-XL Full -> Georgia Rec AMI (0.1186 -> 0.1282) & cuts TE (0.165 -> 0.152).

datasets.name: PTB-XL
datasets.classes: 16 clinical diagnostic subclasses (NORM, IMI, AMI, STTC, LAFB/LPFB, LVH, CLBBB, CRBBB, ...)
datasets.notes: Filtered via ecg-data-repo ptbxl_error_labels.csv (severity <= 2, excluding zero-diagnostic records).

datasets.name: Georgia (CinC 2020)
datasets.classes: 17 SNOMED-CT clinical diagnoses (NSR, AFIB, IAVB, RBBB, SB, STach, TInv, ...)
datasets.notes: High multi-ethnic structural diversity; strong bidirectional zero-shot symmetry with PTB-XL.

datasets.name: Chapman-Shaoxing
datasets.notes: Rhythm-skewed class mix tests UDA robustness against strong class-imbalance shift.
